title: Annotating Certificates when Candidates Take Examinations under Special Conditions
what_it_is: Annotating Certificates when Candidates Take Examinations under Special Conditions

sections.label: SEAB exam access arrangement annotations
sections.summary: SEAB annotates certificates only for significant exam modifications, and universities, polytechnics, ITE and employers are expected not to treat annotations as indicating disability.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: In Singapore, SEAB's policy is to annotate only where there are significant modifications of the examination, such as exemption from specific components and provision of extra time to complete the examination.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Annotation is neither intended to indicate a disability nor to discriminate against the candidate.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: When our autonomous universities, polytechnics and the Institute of Technical Education consider admission applications, they do not take into consideration the annotation of access arrangements in the certificates of the students during the admissions process.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Employers are also expected to abide by the principles of fair and responsible employment set out by the Ministry of Manpower and the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices.

sections.label: Monitoring discriminatory hiring feedback
sections.summary: The Ministry has not come across discriminatory hiring due to access arrangement annotations and will monitor graduate feedback with institutions and agencies like SG Enable.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: My Ministry has not come across cases of discriminatory hiring due to annotations of access arrangement given.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: But we will continue to work with the post-secondary education institutions and community agencies, such as SG Enable, to monitor feedback from graduates.
